findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business_info, check_service_area, get_social_content, start_quick_check, book_repair · Private data: get_business_info, diagnose_appliance_problem, start_quick_check · Public sink: get_social_content.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business_info, check_service_area, get_social_content, start_quick_check, book_repair · Private data: get_business_info, diagnose_appliance_problem, start_quick_check · Public sink: get_social_content

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
